video_subject: I just received USDC. What can I do with it?
video_script: First, make sure the payment actually arrived on the expected network. Then your options depend on the service you use and your country: hold it, transfer it, convert it, or use supported local cash-out options. Don't rush into a trade just because the money is in crypto. Start with the payment basics first.
